gambling.cmd.gamble: /gamble <player number> <stake> [poker|favor] | rules - play dice for gold at a gaming table, or read the rules
gambling.cmd.table: /atable here | remove | list - mark a gaming table, remove the nearest or list them
gambling.cmd.staff: /agamble list | cancel <game> - list running games or refund one
gambling.loading: The gaming tables are still being prepared. Try again in a moment.
gambling.in_world: You need a character in the world to play.
gambling.unavailable: That player cannot play now. No game started.
gambling.busy: One of you already has a game or an invitation.
gambling.same_table: Both players must stand within reach of the same gaming table.
gambling.table_full: This gaming table has as many games as it holds. Wait for one to finish.
gambling.stake_range: Choose a whole stake from {min} to {max} gold.
gambling.invitation_closed: The invitation to play dice has closed. No gold was taken.
gambling.decision: That decision is no longer yours. Check the current game.
gambling.raise_limit: You can raise from 1 to {amount} gold, limited by what both players carry.
gambling.cancelled: The staff cancelled this game. Your gold is being returned.
gambling.draw: A draw. Your stakes and raises are being returned.
gambling.won: You won the match. The pot, less the house cut, is on its way.
gambling.cancelling: Game #{id} is being cancelled and its gold returned.
gambling.no_game: Game #{id} is not running or is saving a decision. Try again in a moment.
gambling.table_busy: This table has a game or invitation. Finish or cancel it first.
gambling.failed: The gaming table could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
